reuse.why: Keeps the single getScheduledAmount as the definition of the expected amount for all steps, reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, and the API field calls the same helper.

duplication.why: The range and approximate rules are written once in getScheduledAmount; no call site recomputes them.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, the API mapping in scheduleModel.toExternal, and call sites only pass their own op.

scope.why: Focused on the schedule amount rule and its callers, with only a cosmetic import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: Replacing the rangeRounding mode with op keeps the helper small, but op is an opt-in untyped string so callers that omit it (e.g. Balance.tsx, the UI lists) silently skip the approximate rule, and forecast-schedules picks its op with a site-local conditional.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No path re-implements the expected-amount rule; Balance.tsx and UI list callers still call getScheduledAmount, just without op.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount (shared/schedules.ts) gains the op parameter and one op === 'isapprox' branch while the earlier rangeRounding parameter and its halfOfRoundedSum branch are removed; every expected-amount path still calls the helper.
